en: Abu Muhammad Abdallah ibn Muhammad ibn Hajjaj ibn al-Yasamin
tr: Ebû Muhammed Abdullâh b. Muhammed İbnü'l-Yâsemîn
ar: أبو محمد عبد الله بن محمد ابن الياسمين

description.tr: Cebirsel şiiri yüzyıllar boyunca Mağrib ve Batı Afrika genelinde standart matematik ders kitabı oldu || Annesi Berberîydi. Cebirin nazım olarak yazılması onu ezberlemeye uygun hale getirdi — Sahra boyunca sözlü iletim için kritik bir özellik. || [Tarih notu] Eseri, Maşrık'tan bağımsız gelişen bir Mağrib matematik geleneğinin varlığını gösterir.
description.en: His algebraic poem became the standard mathematics textbook across the Maghrib and West Africa for centuries — proving that North African mathematics was independent and thriving || His mother was Berber (hence 'al-Yasamin' — from the jasmine-growing region). Writing algebra in verse made it memorizable — a crucial feature for oral transmission across the Sahara. || [Historiographical note] His work demonstrates the existence of a thriving Maghribi mathematical tradition independent of the Mashriq — often overlooked in standard histories of Islamic mathematics.
description.ar: أصبحت أرجوزته الجبرية الكتاب المعياري للرياضيات في المغرب وغرب أفريقيا لقرون || كانت أمه أمازيغية. كتابة الجبر نظماً جعلتها قابلة للحفظ
